steps: vsShot static dist=1.7 dur=22 keys=hold@q:18 at=1
title: Assisted Tree Felling
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: one key fells the tree

caption.heading: Drive up to a tree
caption.text: The ring: yellow in reach, green on the tree, red too thick.

caption.heading: Hold Q
caption.text: The crane swings over, lowers the head, cuts and lifts the tree.

caption.heading: Centre the crane
caption.text: Folds it back and swings it straight ahead, ready to drive on.

caption.heading: From the cab
caption.text: Let go of Q to stop at any time.

note: the user parked the H21D in front of a good tree in savegame 5 (2026-11-21 08:17): film it where it stands
